name: Helvault
description: The Helvault is a silver monolith on Innistrad, made from a piece of the plane's silver moon, that served as a prison for demons and later for Avacyn.

description_citations.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: The Helvault is a silver monolith on Innistrad, made from a piece of the plane's silver moon, that served as a prison for demons and later for Avacyn.

citations.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sorin created it as half of Innistrad's protection, alongside the angel Avacyn, who used it to seal away threats such as demons.

citations.text: "Sorin's Betrayal", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Sorin also imprisoned the lithomancer Nahiri inside it, and she was held there for nearly a millennium.

citations.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sorin's Betrayal", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The demon Griselbrand challenged Avacyn, who drove him into the Helvault, but he impaled her with his spear and the backlashing binding spell drew her in too.

citations.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Griselbrand", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: With Avacyn locked inside, Innistrad was left without its protector and was overrun by creatures of the night.

citations.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Dark Ascension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Liliana Vess forced Thalia, the Guardian of Thraben, to destroy it, releasing Avacyn, Griselbrand and other demons.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Its silver was later forged into swords, such as the sword Eost.

citations.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

status.text: The Helvault was destroyed in the Sundering during the siege of Thraben, and a later story says Avacyn's prison is gone.

citations.text: Banners Raised (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisons Nahiri inside it.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana tracks Griselbrand to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.
timeline.quote: Liliana tracks Griselbrand 's disappearance to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri threatens Sorin after he admits her call for help was absorbed by the Helvault; he banishes her into it.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn.
timeline.quote: She forced the cathar Thalia to destroy the silver Helvault , where Avacyn was held, to reach one of her enemies .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels drew malevolent beings, including Nahiri, into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the Helvault also contained Nahiri

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged Avacyn.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges the angel Avacyn to protect humanity from the vampires, along with the Helvault, and is reviled as a traitor by most vampires.
timeline.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires and other threats

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Creation of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia chooses to save her men, causing the Sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her men, allowing the Sundering of the Helvault to take place.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels imprison the captured demons in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: imprisoning them in a huge mass of silver that came to be called the Helvault

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The demon Griselbrand lands on the Helvault under a full moon and challenges Avacyn to combat.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drives Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impales her heart with his spear, and the backlashing binding spell draws her into the Helvault too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand turns the Helvault against Avacyn, trapping her inside and leaving Innistrad without a protector.
timeline.quote: The demon Griselbrand challenged Avacyn and turned the tables at the last moment

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn is forced into the Helvault, leaving her flights of angels unable to protect Innistrad as before.
timeline.quote: Back before Avacyn was forced into the Helvault

citation.text: "Inboxing Day: Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn at the Helvault; she drives him in but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Disappearance of Balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Innistrad is overrun by creatures of the night while humans near extinction; Avacyn is revealed to be locked in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that Avacyn , the guardian angel created by Sorin is locked in the Helvault .

citation.text: "Dark Ascension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie, forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets, then goes to perform the Sundering.
timeline.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

citation.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana causes the Sundering of the Helvault, freeing Avacyn, who casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir.
timeline.quote: Liliana caused the Sundering of the Helvault , and Avacyn was free.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn and Griselbrand duel on the Helvault; Griselbrand stabs her, her binding spell backlashes, and both fall into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Both the devious demon lord and the wounded angel fell into the Helvault , plunging Innistrad into a time of darkness.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia takes the oath to never allow the Helvault to come to harm.
timeline.quote: Thalia took the same oath that Lothar swore

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia becomes the Guardian of Thraben, unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed.
timeline.quote: Thalia took charge of the elite guardians of Thraben, becoming the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A golden helix streaked from the Helvault, which exploded, and Avacyn emerged free from her prison.
timeline.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

citation.text: Avacyn, Angel of Hope (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Helvault was destroyed and fearful mobs became fearless battalions.
timeline.quote: After the destruction of the Helvault, fearful mobs soon became fearless battalions.

citation.text: Banners Raised (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: This resulted in the release of both the demons and Avacyn

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, Griselbrand and numerous other demons are released from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: has been released from her prisoning, the Helvault .

citation.text: "Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess threatened Thalia, leading to the sundering of the Helvault and the release of Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both Avacyn and the demons were unleashed back into the world.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Disappearance of balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Avacyn's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
timeline.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the Helvault so Avacyn can seal away threats; she battles demons such as Ormendahl for about a thousand years.
timeline.quote: and sealing them within the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks Avacyn into banishing him into the Helvault and pulls her in, sealing them both.
timeline.quote: sealing them both inside

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana coerces Thalia into letting her shatter the Helvault, and it bursts apart, freeing everything inside.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her people and allow Liliana to break open the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn casts the cursemute, letting werewolves choose to fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn was released from the Helvault , she cast a spell that granted the werewolves a choice to either remain a werewolf

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
timeline.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Dovid becomes Comitant Dovid, isolated from the cathars and church officials, carrying the first sword forged from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: That is how I became Comitant Dovid.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Dovid is given Eost, a sword forged from the Helvault, with his name at the top of the honored list.
timeline.quote: I have drawn it only once, during the ceremony where it was presented to me, when Avacyn touched its point.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
timeline.quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
timeline.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn is freed from the Helvault when it shatters.
timeline.quote: A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

citation.text: Avacyn, Angel of Hope (Iconic Masters, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Thalia finds that Avacyn imprisoned her angelic sisters in the Helvault and her faith shatters.
timeline.quote: when she discovered that Avacyn had imprisoned her angelic sisters inside, her unbreakable faith finally shattered

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Helvault's destruction frees Avacyn and Griselbrand; Liliana pursues and destroys Griselbrand at the Ashmouth.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess pursued Griselbrand from Thraben to the Ashmouth, and destroyed him utterly there.

citation.text: "Ashmouth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn to combat; after days of battle she drives him into the Helvault, he impales her with his spear, and both are imprisoned by the rebounding binding spell.
timeline.quote: Griselbrand challenged Avacyn to combat.

citation.text: "Griselbrand", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces the Sundering of the Helvault by pressuring Thalia, freeing Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: she forced the Sundering of the Helvault by forcing an ultimatum on Thalia, its guardian

citation.text: "Griselbrand", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana exhumes Mikaeus's corpse and learns Griselbrand is imprisoned within the Helvault.
timeline.quote: forcing it to reveal that Griselbrand was imprisoned within the Helvault

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges the Helvault from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon.
timeline.quote: Sorin also forged the Helvault from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Betrayal", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin halts the battle by sealing Nahiri within the Helvault for nearly a millennium.
timeline.quote: Sorin halted the battle by sealing Nahiri within the Helvault

citation.text: "Sorin's Betrayal", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A huge silver mass standing in the secret courtyard of the Cathedral of Avacyn.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A silver prison of unpurged evils.

citation.text: Innistrad: card flavor text (Innistrad, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A huge mass of silver said to be a piece of Innistrad's silver moon, holding imprisoned demons and Avacyn, in Thraben Cathedral yard.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A moon-silver prison intended to restrain indestructible diabolical creatures; it now holds Avacyn.

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Prison into which Avacyn was forced.

citation.text: "Inboxing Day: Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A moon-silver obelisk in Thraben Cathedral's courtyard that imprisons demons, Avacyn and Griselbrand.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A silver monolith that imprisoned Avacyn until it shattered in a thunderous explosion; its rubble was used to forge bladed bracers.

citation.text: Avacyn Restored: card flavor text (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The prison whose escapees Avacyn focuses on hunting.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

pages_say.description: The prison in which Avacyn and many demons were held until it opened.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

pages_say.description: The prison that sealed Avacyn and Griselbrand and later split; its silver is forged into swords.
